name: Median Graphs Are Strictly Convex-Treelike
statement: Every finite median graph is cover-recursively peripheral, and the vertex-deleted three-cube is cover-recursively peripheral but not median.
proof: Mulder’s peripheral median expansion recursively supplies median bases and convex median sites. The graph $Q_3^-$ is the peripheral expansion of $Q_2$ along a three-vertex path, while the three neighbors of its missing vertex have no median.
